title: Production
noFactoriesBody: You need to create a factory before you can manage production lines, formulas, and batches.
statusHelp: Click Status to select or deselect all. Use Apply to update filters. All and None set the draft before Apply.
hintRecurringWeek: Default on in week view (includes recurring program runs). Reset status filters to restore defaults for this view.
hintRecurringDay: Default on in day view. Reset status filters to restore defaults for this view.
hintRecurringAll: Default off on All dates. Recurring is on by default in week and day views.
hintRecurringGeneric: Default on in week and day views; off on All dates when status filters are reset.
filterLinesAllAria: Filter by production line. Currently showing all lines.
resetLinesAria: Reset line filter to all lines
activityLoadFailed: Activity totals could not be loaded from the server
activityFallback: — showing counts from loaded batches (last 100 max).
noBatchWindow: No batch data in this window for the current filters.
outliersHint: Yield ±10 pts or time ±15 pts vs line + recipe average
filterDateAria: Filter overview by date range. Current: {{label}}
aboutLinesBody: Each production line is a named collection of machines on the factory floor. Assign which machines can run work on each line.
aboutRecipesBody: Each recipe has its own path and materials. Copy a recipe to reuse a path.
addRecipeHint: Add a recipe to define steps, inputs, and outputs.
selectStepHint: Select a step to edit inputs and outputs.
manageFormula: Manage this formula from one place.
name: Name
addRecipeDialogHint: Create a blank recipe or copy path and materials from another recipe.
completeHint: Enter actual products and duration. Variance will be calculated automatically.
completePostHint: Completing will automatically post product and byproduct quantities to finished goods and waste to the damaged ledger.
batchCompleted: Batch completed — products and waste posted to inventory
cancelHint: This will mark the batch as cancelled. Optionally provide a reason.
startHint: Input items will be deducted from storage. Starting will be blocked if storage is insufficient.
batchStarted: Batch started — inputs deducted from storage
noItemsOnBatch: No items added to this batch.
addItemBeforeStart: Add at least one item before starting.
notEnoughMaterial: Not enough material for input items
formulaDuplicate: A formula with this code or name already exists
activityRecipesHelp: Click Activity recipes to select or deselect all. Use Apply to update the chart. All and None set the draft before Apply.
filterRecipesAllAria: Filter activity by recipe. Currently showing all recipes.
resetRecipesAria: Reset recipe filter to all recipes
formulaCodeOrNameExists: Formula code or name already exists
pickRecipe: Pick a recipe for this run
plannedStartInvalid: Planned start is not a valid date
targetQtyInvalid: Enter a positive integer for target products, or leave blank for the formula default
simpleRunHint: Simple run uses the line and qty on the left. No path or materials.
selectRecipePreview: Select a recipe to preview the path and materials.
noMachinesTooltip: No machines assigned. Add machines before using this line on a recipe or batch.
priorStepsHint: Output from earlier completed steps in this batch. Counts toward Total available; storage only covers the remainder when you start.
availabilityHint: Availability includes storage plus output from earlier completed steps. Remaining need comes from storage when you start. Rows marked This step are used on this step.
noInputsDefault: No input items — no storage deduction needed.
